objective: 0.3.0 pi 6/10: Wire the Pi tool surface from existing Pi tools, extensions and MCP support, adding custom code only where the research finds no existing carrier.
requirements: Maintainer (verbatim): "please add intents for the next 0.3.0 release where I will implement the pi extension integration"; the maintainer implements 0.3.0, so these Intents record the work and carry no Assignments until the maintainer starts it.
Maintainer (verbatim): "in the docs/pi/ it's supposed to use already existent extensions for required functionality" and "the first provider to implement will be kimi for coding global".

Release model: work lands on release/0.3.0/integration cut from main, as one release/0.3.0/<type>/<change> branch and one PR per change; the first PR of the release carries the version bump made with mise run bump:minor.
Done means mise run verify passes with the generated output in sync (mise run build) and CI green on every required check, including the windows job.

Reused as is: Pi's built-in read, grep, find, ls, write, edit and bash replace Read, Grep, Glob, Write, Edit and Bash, enabled per process with --tools and --exclude-tools; Pi's native skills replace Skill; Pi's native prompt templates carry the review first-pass prompts.

Reused as is: the built-in builtin:mcp extension carries MCP-served tools, including the T3 Code tools when the user registers that MCP server; without it html_render and html_preview are reported unavailable and the visual roles report the inspection as blocked.
Reused as is: the built-in builtin:codemode extension hosts the workflow scripts, enabled with defaultTools +codemode or --tools +codemode.
Reused from the shipped examples, loaded explicitly: todo.ts for the task list (TaskCreate, TaskUpdate, TaskList, TaskGet and /todos).

The ask tool (AskUserQuestion) is built from the shipped question.ts and questionnaire.ts examples over ctx.ui.select and input; in print and JSON mode it returns an error and the open decision becomes the blocker only the user can clear.
protected-paths.ts and permission-gate.ts stay unloaded in this Intent, and the experimental pi-durable package is not used.
Maintainer (verbatim): "the pi extension and integration will use a config.json that will set options, functionality, the provider, which will enable/disable its deps, etc".
The config.json from Intent 0.3.0 pi 4/10 selects this: each tool and the existing extension that carries it is on or off per config.json, and a disabled one is not loaded.
Decided (maintainer): web search and fetch come from pi-web-kit, disabled when the provider extension offers web tools (Kimi's moonshot_search and moonshot_fetch).
Decided: @aliou/pi-processes watches long commands such as gh pr checks --watch.
Decided (maintainer: rpiv unless howaboua is better; research found it is not): @juicesharp/rpiv-todo provides the task list and @juicesharp/rpiv-ask-user-question the ask tool.

Decided (maintainer): Billion Context is installed in the pi integration only: the billion-context package, pinned, compressing the root and specialist sessions (delegate.forceEnable), with its own acp_delegate subagents off (pi.subagents false); it replaces pi's compaction.
